summary_plain: All 18 open systems match the proposed physical frame. Essential notation, including high slurs, low ledger-line octaves, pedal marks and final fermatas, is contained by the crops. Every open region is a complete bar of three eighth-note units. The opening clefs are treble above and bass below; no clef changes are printed. Only authorized print images, embedded proposed metadata and geometry assistance were accessed; no reader, candidate, prior review or semantic transcription was used. This submission does not constitute human sign-off.

irregular_checks.question_plain: Do the opening and close require complementary partial bars?
irregular_checks.answer_plain: No. The opening lower staff has six sixteenth notes under a whole-bar upper rest, and the final bar has a dotted-quarter upper note over an eighth note and two eighth rests. Both contain three eighth-note units; no pickup or shortened terminal region is present.

irregular_checks.question_plain: Do the repeat pair and first and second endings align across the system break?
irregular_checks.answer_plain: Yes. The forward repeat begins P003 after two complete introduction bars. The first-ending bracket covers P034-P035 and closes at the backward repeat after P035. The second-ending bracket covers P036-P037 at the next system. These are complete bars; no post-repeat pickup or uncounted region appears. This is a global route check only; frozen system blocks remain bound facts.

irregular_checks.question_plain: Is any printed bar split across a system break without a closing barline?
irregular_checks.answer_plain: No. Every open system has a complete closing barline. Cross-system page context shows ordinary continuation to a new complete bar, including page turns; there is no split region or cadenza. Frozen ranges remain consecutive with the independently counted open ranges.

irregular_checks.answer_plain: No. The opening 3/8 metre and two-sharp signature remain in force. Treble and bass clefs remain on their respective staves, with no mid-bar or cautionary clef changes.

irregular_checks.question_plain: Does essential musical ink extend beyond a proposed crop?
irregular_checks.answer_plain: No. The overlaid boundaries contain the high slurs, dynamics, grace note, hairpins, pedal instructions and releases, low ledger-line notes and final fermatas. Small pieces of neighboring-system ink in overlapping crop margins do not belong to the open system being checked. Labels must remain in separate white margins when the host generates the human report.
